page_title: VER 0-0 CRE | Verona v Cremonese 15/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+4' Amin Sarr (Verona) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Emil Audero makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.

90+1' Jeremy Sarmiento (Cremonese) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Lorenzo Montipo!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
86' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Alessio Zerbin is replaced by Romano Floriani (Cremonese).
80' Substitution. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro will be replaced by Al Musrati (Verona).
80' Paolo Zanetti is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Gift Orban (Verona) suffers an injury and Amin Sarr comes on.
80' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Antoine Bernede and he is replaced by Cheikh Niasse (Verona).
79' Gift Orban (Verona) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
78' Michele Collocolo (Cremonese) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
74' A player from Verona brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
70' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Martin Frese limps off the pitch to be replaced by Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona).
69' Looks like Martin Frese (Verona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
66' The corner is swung in but Cremonese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' Substitution. Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) replaces Antonio Sanabria.

66' A long pass finds Michele Collocolo (Cremonese), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom left corner, but Lorenzo Montipo reacts well to make a good save.
65' Giovane (Verona) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
62' Close! Gift Orban (Verona) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.
62' The referee points to the corner flag and Verona will take a corner.
62' Giovane (Verona) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the left side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Emil Audero.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Warren Bondo departs the field of play to be replaced by Alberto Grassi (Cremonese).
58' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) replacing Federico Bonazzoli.
58' Jeremy Sarmiento (Cremonese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jari Vandeputte.
58' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
56' Suat Serdar (Verona) unleashes a shot from long range but it's well blocked.
52' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
49' Giovane (Verona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Emil Audero makes a comfortable save.
47' Martin Frese (Verona) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
46' The whistle blows and Alberto Arena starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Emil Audero leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Giovane (Verona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
43' Suat Serdar (Verona) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
43' A neat pass is well received by Giovane (Verona), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
40' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) will take a goal kick to hopefully start an attacking move for his team.
35' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) will deliver the corner kick.
34' Gift Orban (Verona) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Emil Audero anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
33' The linesman makes the right call and Verona will have a corner.
32' The resulting corner from Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) comes to nothing.
31' Verona earn a corner.

31' Giovane (Verona) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
29' Paolo Zanetti is forced to make a change. Roberto Gagliardini is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona).
28' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Alberto Arena blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.
24' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
22' Gift Orban (Verona) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
21' What a chance that is! Giovane (Verona) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
17' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

16' Emil Audero was forced into action to thwart Giovane (Verona). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
13' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
11' Verona are ruled offside.
6' Victor Nelsson (Verona) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post!
6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) heads on.
4' Gift Orban (Verona) finds some space for a shot after collecting the ball and unleashes a rocket of a shot from long distance towards the net. The goalkeeper thwarts the effort.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Verona will have the kick-off.
